name: SundownKelvin
summary: Convert a colour temperature in Kelvin to an approximate sRGB colour and hex string.
description:
A Swift port of the kelvin JavaScript library. It runs Tanner Helland's blackbody
approximation to turn a temperature between 1000 K and 40000 K into an sRGB triple
or a hex string. One file, no dependencies. Good for interface tints, not colorimetry.
